on_screen_text.text: Republicans continue to postpone the swearing-in of Adelita Grijalva, the newest Democrat elected to Congress, for a 15th day.
Her day one promise is to be the tie-breaking vote to release the Epstein files.

central_claim: Republicans are deliberately blocking a newly-elected Democrat from being sworn into Congress to prevent her from casting the deciding vote to release the Jeffrey Epstein files, implying a cover-up that involves figures like Donald Trump.
